derivation: or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from H2986 (יָבַל) (in the sense of H2988 (יָבָל));

words.word: and i was by the river

occurrences.text: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
words: and I was by the river

occurrences.text: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
